verdict.rationale: Oneleet offers automation surfaces (Fieldwork AI agents, MCP server, service keys), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The closest items are adjacent: URI-versioned API routes with deprecation notes, draft policy publishing, and control review history. None of these is version history or rollback for user-defined automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
